objectives: Explain how Esau came to meet Jacob in peace.
Describe how Jacob kept wise after the meeting.
takeaways: When a man's ways please the Lord, He maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him (Proverbs 16:7).
The embrace was not proof the hatred was gone; the Most High put peace on Esau in that moment.
Jacob urged his gift on Esau to seal the peace, then declined to travel together and kept his distance.
Jacob built at Succoth and raised an altar, Elelohe-Israel: God, the God of Israel.
